Offline speech recognition API for Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi and servers with Python, Java, C# and Node
Espresso: A Fast End-to-End Neural Speech Recognition Toolkit

repo_meta_data.description: On-device streaming ASR (speech-to-text) for Linux x86_64 + aarch64 — one hardened .so behind Python (PyPI), Node.js (npm), Go (go get), C/C++ (tarball + CMake). AVX2 on servers, NEON on edge. RNN-T + CTC, RTF 0.06–0.08 on x86_64. Same runtime as voxrt-asr-{android,ios}.
